hardware: Ascend 910C; two chips on one card
precision: BF16 weights and activations; FP32 GDN state; HF32 disabled

targeted_tests.scope: Logits, HCCL backend, Ascend GDN and HW2 experiment scripts

measurement_scope.latency: Host streaming, including scheduler, IPC and delivery; profiler disabled
measurement_scope.throughput: Total completed output tokens divided by concurrent-group makespan
measurement_scope.memory: Per-rank PyTorch allocator samples every 200ms; not an exact continuous HBM peak

communication.measurement: Per-rank Chrome device intervals in microseconds; neither rank sums nor rank maxima are request end-to-end latency.
communication.communication_scope: Union of CANN collective envelopes and verified physical HCCL component tasks; envelope-only timing is retained separately.
communication.wait_scope: Union of matched physical HCCL EVENT_WAIT/NOTIFY_WAIT tasks. Wait overlaps communication and computation; it is not an exclusive phase or a quantity to add to end-to-end time.
communication.profiling_scope: Level1, overlap schedule off, child-profiler disable synchronizes NPU after every forward; CPU profiling perturbs dispatch. Independent unprofiled benchmark measures throughput and latency.
communication.standard_communication_time_analysis: No communication.json or communication_time_analysis report was generated; no exclusive Transit Time/Wait Time decomposition is claimed.

decode.scope: Stage task unions; use rank metrics for idle and cross-stage overlap. exposed_communication_against_all_compute_us also accounts for compute attributed to other stages.

prefill.scope: Stage task unions; use rank metrics for idle and cross-stage overlap. exposed_communication_against_all_compute_us also accounts for compute attributed to other stages.

unattributed.scope: Stage task unions; use rank metrics for idle and cross-stage overlap. exposed_communication_against_all_compute_us also accounts for compute attributed to other stages.

backend_recording.scope: Recorded HcclBackend calls; excludes the direct sampling token broadcast. Payload is logical input, not wire bytes.

communication_wait_evidence.source: CANN get_hccl_task_data joins host a.duration AS duration_estimated to AscendTask b.duration AS duration. Timing uses matched hardware Chrome X-event dur; the host estimate is retained only as metadata.
